items.title: Delfeayo Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: I was not around the Raelettes so much. No, it was pretty much the same situation. They’re in the same hotel with us. They may have had some perks, but not a lot.
We just interviewed Bobby Hutcherson. He talked about – his sister was one of the Raelettes. She said that Ray used to fly the plane. I don’t know if . . .

Yeah. I don’t know about that one. It might have been on autopilot. They might have gave him something and say, “Here. You’re flying the plane, Ray.” We used to play chess. Ray used to love to play chess.
